enumHelp.claude-code: Claude Code on your Claude subscription (recommended)
enumHelp.local: Your own model server, e.g. Ollama (experimental, untested)

description: Experimental, untested: the OpenAI-compatible server the local backend runs routines on, and claude-api runs routines whose model is local/<model> on. The default is Ollama on this machine; llama.cpp's llama-server, vLLM, LM Studio and hosted APIs such as DeepSeek, Qwen (DashScope) or Kimi (Moonshot) work too. A server that needs an API key gets it with `auth login local`. Its runs have no list price, so they don't count toward the llm.budget.* budgets.

The model the local backend runs routines on: its name on the server (e.g. qwen3:8b; `ollama list` shows the ones pulled). It replaces the model a routine names, unless that's local/<model>, another model on the same server.

Scheduled runs don't start while the Claude plan's 5-hour or weekly usage is above this share (they're recorded as skipped); runs started by hand still run. A run that hits the plan's limit stops scheduled runs until it resets.
Length of the rolling short budget window.
API spend allowed in the rolling short window (0: no limit); past it, scheduled runs don't start.
API spend allowed in the rolling 7 days (0: no limit); past it, scheduled runs don't start.
How long run history and logs are kept.
Notify me when a run fails, needs a sign-in, or is skipped or missed (clicking one opens the app on the run).
Source checkout `update` builds from when no published release has a download for this machine. Empty: the checkout this build came from.
How much each memories file may hold (every routine's, and each routine's own): what a run's prompt gets, kept small. Past it, `memory add` asks to compact first.
